svg.title: Nine days, plotted against the thing that matters
svg.desc: Altitude profile of the 16-24 September 2026 route. Sleeping altitude rises from 2,165 m at Sarahan to 4,337 m at Chandratal in a sawtooth, with daytime peaks at Komic, Chicham and Kunzum La marked above the sleeping line, then a 2,287 m drop into Manali on the last day.
svg.text: Nine days, plotted against the thing that matters
Solid line: where you sleep. Hollow marks: where you stand in the middle of the day.
three villages above 4,400 m, then sleep 937 m lower
the dip is deliberate: climb high, sleep low
The shape is the acclimatisation plan: five days to gain 1,500 m through Kinnaur, a drop at Kalpa, then the hard part.
